instructions:
knowledge-contract: 1.2.0
Find, then read by section: search(query, fields=["file_path","chunk_id","section","score"]) -> get_document(file_path, chunk_id=..., max_chars=2000). Never page whole files.
Task context in one call: context_pack(query, budget_tokens=3000).
Several vaults: list_vaults, then vault=<slug> on any tool.
file_path is vault-relative. New-parameter errors start with a stable E_ code.
